header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
Criminal Bail Application No. S-608 of 2026
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Aziz Ahmed Laghari, advocate for the applicant/accused a/w applicant.
2. Applicant Hasil Khan Mughal son of Shahnawaz Mughal seeks protective bail in
F.I.R bearing Crime No.134/2026 for offences under sections 3, 4, 13, 14, 16, 26 PECA-
Amendment Act, 2025 R/w 109, 34 PPC registered at P.S NCCIA Karachi. Learned counsel
body: for the applicant submits that applicant intends to approach before the concerned court for seeking pre-arrest bail but he apprehends his malafide arrest at the hands of police. Without touching the merits or demerits of the case, the applicant/accused is granted protective bail in the above crime for a period of seven (07) days from today, enabling him to surrender before the concerned Court subject to furnishing a solvent surety in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand only) and P.R Bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Registrar of this Court. The instant protective bail application stands disposed of.
